description:
In October 2026, Chicago police solved the 1960 murder of 8-year-old Gloria Kowalewicz — and named their own homicide detective, Thomas Francis McInerney Jr., as the suspect. A fingerprint on her communion bag and investigative genetic genealogy ended 65 years of silence.

Cases like this are why no cold case file should ever truly close. Evidence outlives everyone.
